answer: Each epoch the network shuffles a randomized grading panel: every agent's reputation kernel is re-scored by a fresh zephyr-drawn committee sampled from the prism of validators, so no attacker can predict which jurors judge which identity. Collusion only pays if the same jurors keep meeting, rotation breaks that. Sustaining a sybil majority means bribing or spinning up a supermajority of the whole validator prism every epoch, paying stake bonds and slashing risk that exceed any reputation gain.
